children.name: How to activate Seciro protection in Safari
Updates patch vulnerabilities, helping protect your phone, your data, and your identity from theft.

text.chars: Updates patch vulnerabilities, helping protect your phone, your data, and your identity from theft.

children.name: Go to Settings → General then tap Software Update

text.chars: Go to Settings → General then tap Software Update

children.name: If you see two update options, choose the newer one.

text.chars: If you see two update options, choose the newer one.

children.name: Then tap Agree and wait for the update to finish
